X1.evidence: Sec 2-3 and appendix (p.3-12): one GPT-3 model (text-davinci-003) read out via token probabilities; digit versus number-word forms, separators and stimulus position varied as stimulus versions, each as a separate experiment.

X2.evidence: ANOVAs (for example for digits, F(7,4312) = 15.06) test the cognitive effect of the stimulus, not a source of simulation uncertainty.

X3.evidence: Stimulus-format variants are tied to the effect under test, so coding them as sources is borderline.
